sections.h2: What are the options for selling a house in Greenacres?
sections.html:
Greenacres owners can list through an agent, sell on their own, or take a cash offer for the house in its current condition. Speed, repairs and certainty pull in different directions.

  • Agent listing: more buyers, with showings, inspections and a lender to wait on.
  • Private sale: you control price and terms and handle paperwork yourself.
  • Cash offer: fewer conditions, a flexible closing date and a price that reflects repairs.

Put offers in writing and compare what you would net after payoffs, taxes and recording charges.

sections.h2: What is Greenacres, and how did it start?
sections.html:
Greenacres is a small city in central Palm Beach County, covering about six square miles by the county history's account and 5.94 square miles of land by the Census.

The Palm Beach County history site says developer Lawrence Carter Swain platted half the townsite in 1923 and began selling lots in 1925 for $225 with $45 down. The Town of Greenacres City was incorporated in 1926, with about 1,250 residents. The hurricanes of 1926 and 1928 hit the town hard. After Swain died in 1944, about 125 residents petitioned the Legislature to annul the charter, soldiers fought it, and the city's rights were reinstated in December 1945 and it was reincorporated in 1947. The city was renamed in 1980 and has been named a Tree City USA.

That history of modest lots for working families still shows in the housing stock, which is compact and mostly built in the late twentieth century.

sections.h2: What do the Census numbers say about Greenacres housing?
sections.html:
Greenacres is more owner-occupied than its neighbors: 66.5 percent of units were owner-occupied in 2020 to 2024, and the median value was $291,000.

Median gross rent is $1,756, and median monthly owner costs are $1,865 with a mortgage and $672 without. Households average 2.90 persons, and 15,249 households were counted. Median household income is $70,491 in 2024 dollars. These figures describe family-sized homes with higher carrying costs than rent in most of the region, so buyers will compare your price with what they pay now.

sections.h2: Who lives in Greenacres, and how does that affect a sale?
sections.html:
The city is dense and diverse. QuickFacts lists 7,407 people per square mile, 43.3 percent foreign-born residents, and 58.1 percent of people age 5 and older speaking a language other than English at home.

For a seller, that means many buyers are first-time buyers or growing families, and many conversations happen in more than one language. Provide documents in clear form, and use a translator or a bilingual closing agent if the buyer asks. Written offers and a plain purchase agreement prevent misunderstandings that cost time at title.

The commute averages 29.9 minutes, the longest among the cities in this region, so buyers weigh road access to jobs along the coast. Labor force participation is 65.1 percent, and 23.0 percent of persons under 65 lack health insurance, a sign that some households run on tight budgets.

sections.h2: What taxes and fees come with a Greenacres sale?
sections.html:
A deed in Palm Beach County pays documentary stamp tax at 70 cents per $100 of consideration, and the clerk collects it with recording fees.

Section 201.02(1)(a) treats any mortgage on the property as part of the consideration. The Department of Revenue notes that all parties are liable for the tax, whichever one agrees to pay. Recording runs $5.00 for the first page and $4.00 for each additional page under s. 28.24(13), plus trust fund and technology charges. The settlement statement shows the totals.

sections.h2: How do property tax dates and homestead work in Greenacres?
sections.html:
The assessment date is January 1, and the Palm Beach County Property Appraiser mails the TRIM notice in August.

A value challenge is a petition filed with the clerk within 25 days of that notice. Tax bills arrive in November with a 4 percent discount that steps down to 1 percent in February, and delinquency begins April 1. Homestead and other exemptions are filed by March 1.

  • Homestead: up to $50,000, with the extra $25,000 applying only to non-school taxes.
  • Save Our Homes: the yearly increase is capped at the lower of 3 percent or CPI.
  • On a sale, the assessment resets to just value the next January 1.

Ask the Palm Beach County tax collector for the balance due through your closing date.

sections.h2: What if the Greenacres house is inherited, in foreclosure or rented?
sections.html:
Each has a state timeline.

  • Inherited: summary administration is available for a non-exempt estate of $150,000 or less, or after two years from death (s. 735.201).
  • Foreclosure: a public sale falls 20 to 35 days after final judgment, with a 5 percent deposit and a 10 day objection window (s. 45.031).
  • Tenant: a month-to-month tenancy ends on at least 30 days' notice before a monthly period closes (s. 83.57).

With about a third of Greenacres units renter-occupied, tenant questions are common. Share the lease with any buyer at the outset.

sections.h2: What does the Greenacres commute and economy suggest?
sections.html:
Retail sales were $896,674 thousand in 2022, health care and social assistance receipts were $137,603 thousand, and accommodation and food services sales were $100,647 thousand, according to QuickFacts. Per capita income is $35,145 in 2024 dollars, and 14.8 percent of persons are in poverty.

Households that commute nearly half an hour often value road access, so mention the nearest major roads and shopping when you talk to a buyer. Bachelor's degree attainment among adults is 26.1 percent, and 84.3 percent have a high school diploma or higher. Those facts help you picture buyers who are working households sizing up a first purchase, so a clean, move-in-ready house will show well and an unrepaired one will need a discount.

sections.h2: What should a Greenacres seller line up before closing?
sections.html:
Missing records delay more closings than buyers do, so gather them early.

  • Deed, trust or probate papers showing who can sign.
  • Payoff letters for each mortgage or lien recorded in Palm Beach County.
  • Permit and repair records for roof, electrical and air conditioning work.
  • Lease copies and rent history for tenants.
  • Your latest TRIM notice and tax bill.

A deed needs two subscribing witnesses under s. 689.01. Schedule the signing with your title agent.

faqs.a: Yes. The Census lists a 66.5 percent owner-occupied rate for 2020 to 2024, higher than the other cities covered in this region.

faqs.q: What is the median home value in Greenacres?
faqs.a: QuickFacts lists $291,000 for 2020 to 2024. Treat it as a loose reference and get written offers for your own house.
The city's history says it was incorporated in 1926 as the Town of Greenacres City, lost its charter in a 1944 petition, and was reinstated in December 1945.

faqs.q: Who pays doc stamp tax on a Greenacres deed?
faqs.a: All parties are liable by statute. The contract assigns it, and the closing agent collects it at recording.

faqs.q: When must I file homestead after buying in Greenacres?
faqs.a: File DR-501 with the Palm Beach County Property Appraiser by March 1 of the tax year, and own and live in the home by January 1.
